name: Camp KV
description_short: State-licensed co-ed day camp run by the Kennebec Valley YMCA on Maranacook Lake in Readfield, Maine, for ages 5 to 14. Camp is booked one week at a time, with swimming, boating, archery, arts and crafts, nature, field sports and disc golf.
swim_waterfront_notes: Camp is on Maranacook Lake, with swimming and boating. A 2-week Lifeguard/Leader in Training program for ages 12 to 14 teaches CPR, water scanning and shallow water rescues. The pages don't describe swim tests or waterfront supervision.

warnings: Filled zip 04355: Readfield has one ZIP code (2020 Census)
Old season: the page shows only the 2026 season (June 15 - August 21, 2026), and that season has already ended as of today (2026-10-13). No 2027 dates or prices are posted yet.

The 10 day-camp weeks were worked out from the overall range 'June 15th - August 21st', the note that 'Sessions are broken into one-week programs', and the note that Week 3 is June 29-July 2. The page does not list each week by itself.

Prices come in two tiers. Session prices and price_per_week/min/max use the Y Member rate. Non-member rates are $260/week, $208 for the 4-day week, $550 for LG/LIT and $780 for CIT. price_max ($780) is the non-member CIT rate.
LG/LIT dates are listed as July 6-12, which runs Monday through Sunday. That is unusual for a day camp, so the end date may be a typo.
The street address on the page (31 Union St., Augusta, ME 04330) belongs to the YMCA's main building, not the camp site in Readfield.
